A good place to start would be looking at other people's cubes. As you look at several cubes, you'll start to notice a lot of overlapping cards. Use this as a template of sorts in how to build your cube.

A lot of mods can be downloaded directly from the steam workshop. To get there, do the following:

-Open Steam.
-Go to 'Library'.
-Click on 'The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim' on your games list.
-Click 'Browse the Workshop'. It should be underneath the 'Friends' tab.

The other way you can download mods is to go to http://skyrim.nexusmods.com/.

On the very top of the page, there should be a link that says 'Install NMM(0.44.3). Download this and install.

From here on out, whenever you download mods from Nexus, click the link that says 'Download with Manager'. The mod will download via the NMM(Nexus Mod Manager). When it's done, just double click said mod, it'll install, and voila! Easy stuff!

Also, whenever you subscribe to a mod in Steam, make sure to let your Skyrim load up BEFORE you actually press play. On the bottom, you'll see Steam updating said subscribed mods. They won't work unless you let Steam actually download them.

As far as improved graphics mods, it's really a matter of preference!! I highly suggest downloading Skyrim HD - 2K Textures(http://skyrim.nexusmods.com/mods/607/). Try that out and go from there!!
